code='''def transform(grid):\n    n=len(grid)\n    # Cells are separated by full-width and full-height 8 lines.\n    sep_r=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v==8 for v in row)]\n    sep_c=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[i][j]==8 for i in range(n))]\n    row_ranges=[]; a=0\n    for s in sep_r+[n]:\n        if a<s: row_ranges.append((a,s))\n        a=s+1\n    col_ranges=[]; a=0\n    for s in sep_c+[len(grid[0])]:\n        if a<s: col_ranges.append((a,s))\n        a=s+1\n    out=[r[:] for r in grid]\n    rows={}; cols={}\n    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(row_ranges):\n        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(col_ranges):\n            vals={grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if grid[r][c] not in (0,8)}\n            for v in vals:\n                rows.setdefault(ri,set()).add(v); cols.setdefault(ci,set()).add(v)\n    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(row_ranges):\n        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(col_ranges):\n            colors=rows.get(ri,set()) & cols.get(ci,set())\n            # Normally distinct projected colors combine as ARC color 6 for 2+3.\n            color=next(iter(colors)) if len(colors)==1 else (6 if colors else None)\n            if color is None:\n                # row or column projection independently; row takes precedence\n                cs=rows.get(ri,set()) or cols.get(ci,set())\n                color=next(iter(cs)) if cs else 0\n            for r in range(r0,r1):\n                for c in range(c0,c1): out[r][c]=color\n    return out\n'''
